fallback: Return channels: [] when nothing fits. Never assign Interdimensional Customs; USB.tv handles it automatically.

channels.name: Cartoons
channels.description: Any and all animated content. Animation is the medium, not an age group or tone.
include: 2D or 3D animation, stop motion, anime, animated shows and animated internet clips
Animated music videos and animated sketches can also match other channels
exclude: Pure live action with incidental graphics or a brief animated logo

channels.name: Documentaries
channels.description: Anything educational, including serious documentaries and silly, dumb, zany or informal learning.
include: Documentaries, explainers, factual analysis and learning
Vsauce, CGP Grey, informative tier lists
Educational comedy when there is substantive explanation or information
exclude: A tier-list format or scientific-sounding premise alone, with no substantive educational content

channels.name: Interdimensional Cable
channels.description: Shitty humour, randomness and intentionally surreal or nonsensical premises; funny because it makes no sense.
include: Absurd edits, bizarre premises, surreal internet comedy and deliberately incoherent sketches
Randomness that is itself the joke
exclude: Ordinary comedy solely because it is funny
A weak match used as a universal miscellaneous bucket

channels.name: Sunday Morning Prerecorded
channels.description: A spoof of SNL: sketch/skit-based comedy.
include: Saturday Night Live/SNL sketches and digital shorts
MADtv, The Whitest Kids U Know, and other skit-based content
Recognisable sketch formats, including musical sketches
exclude: Stand-up or general funny clips without a sketch/skit structure

channels.name: Now That's What I Call Shit!
channels.description: Music videos and anything predominantly music.
include: Music videos, performances, songs, remixes and musical mashups
Animated or comedic music where listening to the music is the primary experience
exclude: Spoken music analysis or artist interviews that are predominantly speech
positive_examples: User-confirmed Buffy: Once More, with Feeling musical excerpt

channels.name: TTTV
channels.description: Personal-interest channel: physics, gay/LGBTQ+ subjects, drag queens, and SNL. Any one of these interests is sufficient.
include: Physics content, whether educational or entertaining
Gay/LGBTQ+ themes, explicit references, stories and culture
Drag queens, drag performances and drag-related content
SNL content
exclude: Guessing a real person's sexuality from appearance or mannerisms
All science by default: physics is the specified science interest
positive_examples: User-confirmed Buffy: Once More, with Feeling musical excerpt

channels.name: Goblin TV
channels.description: Team Fortress 2, goblincore, and very short surreal content.
include: Team Fortress 2/TF2 footage, machinima, animations and memes
Goblincore: earthy, mossy, mushroomy, woodland, creature/foraging/collected-trinket aesthetics
Very short surreal clips, which can overlap with Interdimensional Cable
exclude: Every fantasy video simply because goblins might exist
Ordinary short clips without surreal content

channels.name: CRTV
channels.description: Content originally released strictly before 2005 (2004 or earlier). This is an era channel, independent of genre.
include: Episodes, films, sketches and clips with supported original release year before 2005
Qualifying Voyager, Friends, Buffy the Vampire Slayer and old Simpsons episodes
exclude: Modern work with a retro/CRT visual style alone
Assigning an old series' entire run without establishing the relevant episode era
Using a modern upload, remaster, file modification or container creation date as the original release date
positive_examples: User-confirmed Buffy: Once More, with Feeling musical excerpt

definitions.Animation: Animated medium, including anime, stop motion and 3D animation.
definitions.Comedy: Content primarily intended to be funny; can accompany more specific genres.
definitions.Sketch Comedy: Performed skits and comedy sketches, including SNL, MADtv and WKUK.
definitions.Documentary: Nonfiction documentary presentation of real subjects, people or events.
definitions.Education: Explanations, demonstrations or analysis intended to teach or inform, even if silly.
definitions.Science: Scientific concepts, research and explanations, including physics.
definitions.Technology: Computing, engineering, technical systems and technology.
definitions.Nature: Wildlife, natural history and the natural world.
definitions.Drama: Scripted dramatic fiction, including drama series and films.
definitions.Sci-Fi: Science-fiction narratives, settings or substantive fictional themes.
definitions.Fantasy: Fantasy narratives, magical settings or mythic fictional themes.
definitions.Horror: Content primarily built around fear, dread, the uncanny or horror storytelling.
definitions.Music: Music is a central subject or experience; music background alone is insufficient.
definitions.Gaming: Games, gameplay, game culture, machinima and substantive game-related content.
definitions.Entertainment: Entertainment that does not fit a more specific genre; use sparingly.
definitions.News & Current Affairs: News reporting, current-affairs discussion and analysis.
definitions.Sport: Sport, sporting performance and sport analysis.
definitions.Lifestyle: Daily life, crafts, style, cooking, home and practical lifestyle content.
definitions.Experimental: Experimental audiovisual work or unconventional artistic form.

tags.guidance: Specific subjects, franchises, aesthetics and subgenres; keep genres separate. Use only evidence-supported topics.

copy.description: One or two concise factual sentences. Identify supported studios/brands/fictional characters. Distinguish fan edits from official releases. No invented facts.
copy.taglines: Disabled: do not generate, scrape, replace or export taglines. Existing manually authored USB.tv values are outside this workflow.

release_date_rule: CRTV requires an evidenced original release year <=2004 for this specific content. Unknown year is null and means no CRTV assignment; explain uncertainty. Do not use an upload date, file timestamp, visual style or series launch year alone.
open_editorial_assumptions: Very short surreal uses a provisional 60-second threshold for Goblin TV; TF2/goblincore do not have this length limit.
Long compilations receive channels only for their predominant or consistently present content; incidental one-off frames or lines do not qualify.
